title: 第23章 六十岁第24章 仙人至
lines: 一转眼，白羽已经回来一个多月了。
这天，他打算去附近府城打探打探消息。
此地所在乃是云州，目前归属汉王管辖。
他倒也不错，地盘打造的井井有条。
一切官员任用，他都尽量挑那些想做事却不得重用之人，这些人一上任当然是急不可耐的证明自己。
除少数，大多数还是有点实力。
最近的府城，这里还挺热闹，已经赶上京城落魄的时候
闲逛一阵，白羽来到一间大酒楼。
这回好了，不用他去问就能听见许多消息。
“不得了呀，那闯王麾下第十八号义子当真神勇，使得一把大锤一砸便能砸死十几人，战场上所向披靡。”
“是啊，如今汉王难办了，除不掉那人就万事皆休。”
“正所谓兵雄雄一个，将雄雄一窝，那人如此悍不畏死，底下人全都跟随他悍勇杀敌，如何不成事？”
“汉王难道就没想办法除掉他？”
“如何除？那人身披重甲又刀枪不入，身边还有高手护持。
乌河一战，汉王不就派高手入场前去刺杀么，他包得跟粽子似的，谁能一击就杀了他？
一击不能致命，闯王麾下高手立即就会出手。”
“哎～，局势不利呀，我等好不容易有安生日子过，却转眼又要变天。”
“那人我晓得，原是前几年朝廷的武状元……”
听这些人谈论，白羽微微一笑深藏功与名。
秦国安果然非凡人，一出京城便犹如蛟龙入海。
一年不到，竟已混出名头来。
他本就从小练外功，底子就在那儿，哪怕伤了一回也无碍，金钟罩会助他复原。
别看名字叫金钟罩，实际与那种只能挨打的还是差了许多，毕竟白羽本来就是奔着金刚不坏神功去练得。
不存在罩门，前五层便可将所有罩门根除，后面七层全是提升力量和提升抗击打能力还有续航能力之类的。
秦国安也不用练到多高，只需练到第八层就够用。
前八层都不难，以秦国安的底子绝对能短时间练成，后面四层才是上难度的时候。
听完最近局势变化，白羽结了账就回去了。
随后的日子一如这般，每月来一次打听局势。
春去秋来，转眼又是一坤年。
这天，白羽六十大寿。
甲子寿，当庆贺。
满满一桌子菜，开吃之前白羽举杯道：“时间过得真快啊，一转眼土都快埋到脖子了。
遥想当年，我也是青葱少年……”
这话，霜儿很难认同，因为白羽看起来和她就是同龄人
发了一会儿牢骚，白羽举杯道：“来来来，咱们吃。”
他这边岁月静好。
皇宫里可就不太平了。
皇帝正在大发雷霆用鞭子吃哒下人。
“废物！
都是废物！
全都是废物！”
经历这两年半时间，赵氏朝廷已经废掉了。
偌大的国土，如今只剩京师这一座孤城。
去年，邑王被闯王打得节节败退，他不甘心就此退出争霸，于是将目光盯上只剩半州之地的朝廷。
content_en:
In the blink of an eye, Bai Yu has been back for more than a month.
On this day, he planned to go to a nearby city to inquire about information.
This place is located in Yunzhou, which is currently under the jurisdiction of the King of Han.
He's not bad at all, and he builds his territory in an orderly manner.
In all official appointments, he tried his best to select those who wanted to do things but could not be reused. Of course, these people were eager to prove themselves as soon as they took office.
Except for a few, most still have some strength.
The nearest Fucheng is quite lively, and it has already caught up with the capital when it was in decline.
After wandering around for a while, Bai Yu came to a large restaurant.
This time it was better, he could hear a lot of news without asking.
"It's incredible. The 18th adopted son of King Chuang is so brave that he can kill more than a dozen people with a single blow of a sledgehammer. He is invincible on the battlefield."
"Yes, the King of Han is in trouble now. If we can't get rid of that person, everything will be over."
"As the saying goes, if a soldier is strong, a general will be strong. That man is so brave that he is not afraid of death, and all the people below him follow him to kill the enemy bravely. How can it not happen?"
"Didn't the King of Han think of a way to get rid of him?"
"How to get rid of him? That person is heavily armored and invulnerable, and he is protected by experts.
During the battle at Wuhe, didn't the King of Han send experts to assassinate him? He was wrapped like a rice dumpling. Who could kill him with one blow?
One blow cannot be fatal, and the masters under King Chuang will take action immediately. "
"Hey~, the situation is unfavorable. I finally had a peaceful life, but things will change again in the blink of an eye."
"I know that man. He was the top military scholar in the imperial court a few years ago..."
Listening to these people talking, Bai Yu smiled slightly to hide his merit and fame.
Qin Guoan is indeed an extraordinary person. As soon as he leaves the capital, he is like a dragon entering the sea.
In less than a year, he has become famous.
He has been practicing external martial arts since he was a child, and the foundation is there. Even if he is injured once, it will not matter, the golden bell will help him recover.
Even though the name is Golden Bell Shield, it is actually much different from the kind that can only be beaten. After all, Bai Yu originally trained for the indestructible power of the Vajra.
There are no cover doors. The first five levels can eradicate all cover doors. The next seven levels are all about improving strength, resistance to damage, and battery life.
Qin Guoan doesn't need to practice to a high level, he only needs to practice to the eighth level.
The first eight levels are not difficult. With Qin Guoan's foundation, he can definitely master it in a short time. The next four levels are the time to get more difficult.
After hearing about the recent changes in the situation, Bai Yu paid the bill and went back.
The days that followed continued like this, coming once a month to inquire about the situation.
Spring passes and autumn comes, and in the blink of an eye it’s another year.
Today is Bai Yu's sixtieth birthday.
Jiazishou should be celebrated.
There was a table full of dishes. Before starting to eat, Bai Yu raised his glass and said, "Time flies so fast. In a blink of an eye, the soil is almost up to your neck."
Looking back on those days, I was also a young boy..."
It's hard for Shuang'er to agree with this, because Bai Yu seems to be the same age as her.
After complaining for a while, Bai Yu raised his glass and said, "Come on, let's eat."
The years are quiet here for him.
Things were not peaceful in the palace.
The emperor was furious and whipped his servants to death.
"Trash!
It's all rubbish!
It's all rubbish! "
After these two and a half years, the Zhao court has been abolished.
In such a huge country, now only the capital city is left.
Last year, the king of Yi was defeated by King Chuang. He was unwilling to quit the fight for hegemony, so he set his sights on the court, which only had half the state left.
title_en: Chapter 23 Sixty Years Old Chapter 24 The Immortal Arrives
